jobs.name: agent-ops
jobs.label: weekly team review
jobs.produces: agent-ops-<date>.md in the reports dir: at most 5 proposed team changes with evidence

jobs.name: housekeeping
jobs.label: cleanup report
jobs.produces: housekeeping-<date>.md: what could be cleared (old transcripts, stale state, backup files); deletes nothing

jobs.name: pending-work
jobs.label: pending-work report
jobs.produces: pending-work-<date>.md: uncommitted work, unpushed commits, unmerged branches in $AODD_REPOS (only written when something is pending)

jobs.name: memory-backup
jobs.label: memory backup
jobs.produces: a git commit (and push, when a remote is set) of $AODD_MEMORY; skipped when it is not a git repo
